title: C1 - confidence should collapse when a ticket belongs to two teams
note: Four unambiguous tickets and three that genuinely span teams. The documented confidence for the shoe ticket is 1.0 and for the three-way ticket 0.42 (choice returns, probabilities 0.61/0.35/0.04). The gap between the two groups is what makes confidence-gated routing possible at all.

states.state: My running shoes arrived in the wrong size. Can I swap them for a size 10?
The tracking page has said 'label created' for nine days now. Where is my package?
I was charged $120 twice for the same order. Please reverse the duplicate charge.
The box arrived crushed and the shoes inside are badly scuffed. I would like a different pair.
Shoes arrived two weeks late and in the wrong size. Also I see two charges of $120 on my card. What are you going to do about this?
states.note: Documented: choice returns, confidence 0.42, probabilities returns 0.61 / billing 0.35 / shipping 0.04.

states.state: My order showed up a week late and by then I no longer needed it. Can I send it back?
states.note: Written as ambiguous, but the model reads 'can I send it back' as plainly returns at confidence 0.90. Kept in the clear group: the mis-specification was the case author's, not the answer's.

states.state: I paid for two pairs but only one arrived, and my card shows the full amount.
The courier left the box out in the rain and everything inside is soaked. I want my money back for the whole order.
states.note: Damage in transit (shipping), a damaged item (returns), and a refund request (billing) at once. Observed 0.84: the model resolves 'primary request' more decisively than the case author expected. Recorded as a hypothesis miss.
